newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Cutlery faces NASDAQ delisting.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Cutlery faces NASDAQ delisting.

text.p: International Cutlery Ltd said Thursday that its stock and warrants could be delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap market because they did not meet the criteria.
The company said it received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock and Class A and B warrants ran the risk of being delisted unless their "deficiencies" were corrected.
"The Company does not believe that it will be able to satisfy the maintenance criteria," it said. "As a result the common stock and warrants may be traded on the over-the- counter market."
